name: Blank cloth last-name tape, dark-blue
size_basis: 5 1/4 x 1 in: the tape loops of the OCP/utility uniform (GL/PD 14-04B, as modelled in garment-ocp-coat-abu-cut name_tape / cap_tape landmarks); CAPR 39-1 7.1.1.2.3 says only that the tape matches the hook panel length. Colours: Fig A6-3 (figure shows bright ultramarine and a teal-leaning dark blue).
provenance: in-house construction; shape, merrowed edge and stitch line only, no lettering

cloth_color.note: dark blue (family cloth blue, as the utility-uniform tapes)

landmarks_note: rects are {x,y,w,h} in user units (0.01 in); text_zone is where the white (ultramarine) or silver (dark blue) lettering goes, centred, letter height up to 0.72 in

text.content: member's legal last name (diacritics and hyphens allowed, all letters one height)

fastener: sew-on or hook-and-loop (Velcro) back; tapes and rank must be all sewn or all Velcro (7.1.1.1)
documented: name tape right chest, CAP tape left chest on the uniforms that take them (7.1.1.2.3, 5.1.x)
white lettering on ultramarine or silver lettering on dark blue (10.9.8-9)
